title: Business and ethical concerns in domestic Conversational Generative AI-empowered multi-robot systems
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is investigating the ethical and moral implications of integrating Large Language Models and conversational AI into domestic multi-robot systems. It uses a qualitative study (workshops) to identify, categorize, and analyze ethical concerns like maleficence and trustworthiness, and it proposes the MORUL framework for ethical development.
